entry.summary: 对于 set $X$, $S subset.eq cal(P)\(X\)$ 被称为 $X$ 上的一个 $sigma$-algebra, if 其满足: + $nothing in X$\; + closed under complement: if $E in S$ then $X\\E in S$\; + closed under countable union: if $E_1\,E_2\,dots.h.c in S$ then $union.big_(k = 1)^oo E_k in S$. 如果第三条并不满足, 而是只满足 closed under finite union, 则称 $S$ 是 $X$ 上的一个 [algebra of sets]. 当然, $sigma$-algebra 是比 algebra 严格更强的条件.

entry.summary: Let $X$ be a set, $cal(M)$ be a $sigma$-algebra on $X$. We call $\(X\,cal(M)\)$ a measurable space. \ A [measure] on this measurable space is a function $mu : cal(M) arrow.r\[0\,oo\)$ satisfying: + $mu\(nothing\)= 0$ + countable additive: $ mu\(union.big_(i = 1)^oo E_i\)= sum_(i = 1)^oo mu\(E_i\) $ for disjoint seq of $E_i in cal(M)$. 我们称 $\(X\,cal(M)\,mu\)$ 为一个 measure space.

entry.summary: Let $S$ be a $sigma$-algebra on set $X$. \ Claim: + $X in S$ [ Directly from def. ] + $D\,E in S arrow.r.double.long D union E\,D inter E\,D\\E in S$ [ union: from def by leaving others as $nothing$\; \ intersection: $ \(D inter E\)^C= D^C union E^C in S $ setminus: $ D\\E = D inter\(X\\E\)in S $ ] + $D\,E in S arrow.r.double.long D Delta S in S$ [ $ D Delta E =\(D\\E\)union.big\(E\\D\) $ ] + $A_1\,A_2\,dots.h.c in S arrow.r.double.long inter.big_(i = 1)^oo A_i in S$ [ $ \(inter.big_(n = 1)^oo\)^C= union.big_(n = 1)^oo E_n^C in S $ ]
